strategy_prompt: Use the provided image as the reference. Produce a NEW, original image of the same subject (P.Louise Obsessed For Less Skincare Set). Keep the product itself EXACTLY the same — identical shape, colour, materials, proportions, branding, logos and any printed text. Match the visual style and MEDIUM of the reference: if it is a photograph keep it photographic; if it is illustrated, cartoon or animated, keep that exact style and do NOT make it photorealistic. Refresh the specific background details and change the camera angle so it reads as a new, original shot rather than a copy — but keep the change moderate and do not invent an unrelated scene. Keep the SAME TYPE of setting as the reference (originally: Outdoors, slightly blurred background showing what looks like a patio or garden area, enhancing the UGC feel): you may vary the specific decor, props, colours and layout for originality, but the scene must stay the same kind of place — a kitchen stays a kitchen, a bedroom stays a bedroom, a bathroom stays a bathroom, an outdoor shot stays outdoors. IMPORTANT — preserve the original composition: keep a person holding the box (showing the hand), in the same pose and framing as the reference; do NOT remove the person or change what they are doing. Keep the product the clear main focus. Any overlaid marketing caption from the reference may be removed. Output aspect ratio 3:4.
